description:
## Why
A successful launch response must not strand an unattended worker at a shell continuation prompt for forty minutes. Backlog item: C8.

## Evidence
- Existing C11-258 reports two 1.1–1.3 KB --prompt launches (Claude Code and Codex) stopping at quote> while a roughly 500-byte prompt worked, with no agent process. Preserve this incident; the ticket’s MAX_CANON attribution is a hypothesis to distinguish from quoting/paste corruption.
- BACKLOG C8 records a 2026-10-01 --prompt-file launch in tab:113 stuck at > for forty minutes.
- c11 on origin/main (`0ff8887e5e`): `CLI/c11.swift:2394-2406` reads --prompt-file into a string; `Sources/DefaultAgentResolver.swift:685-699` embeds positional/flag prompts in a shell line; `Sources/SocketHandlers/SocketDispatch.swift:1389` sends that line and `:1401-1411` uses a fixed delay for post-boot prompts; `:1424-1443` returns success refs without proving process startup.
- Upstream: cmux #9875, Ghostty `f27772d10`, serializes bracketed paste as one IO message. This is a related corruption mechanism, not proof that it caused tab:113.
- Research: report 05 “The gap: top ten” #4; report 06 §1d delivery/submission distinctions; BACKLOG C8. Update C11-258 rather than create a duplicate.

## Scope
In: reproduce the launch stall, distinguish shell quoting/line limits from bracketed-paste interleaving, deliver long initial prompts through a file reference, and make launch status truthful for the tested failure paths.
Out: Ghostty atomic-paste patch (H-A), general send contract (C3), cold PTY lifecycle repairs (H-B), remote launch/holder work, new agent adapters and a universal readiness detector.

## Approach
Keep the shell launch line short; stage a private file inside c11-owned runtime storage and use the supported file-reference path or a brief that tells the agent to read it. Preserve the original prompt content without shell interpolation. Explicitly define file lifetime/cleanup so a delayed startup still reads it. Reuse the launch composer for --prompt and --prompt-file, including any saved-config path sharing it. Bound startup evidence collection off main; distinguish launch accepted/pending from observed started and surface a bounded failure for the continuation-prompt reproducer. Do not call a returned tab ref startup proof.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A reproducer with 500-byte, 1.3 KB and a substantially longer (for example 32 KiB) prompt reaches the intended agent through both --prompt and --prompt-file, without > / quote> or a truncated brief. Verify the expected full content, not just the launch exit code.
2. Fixtures containing quotes, backticks, dollar substitutions, Unicode, newlines and a prompt-file path with spaces preserve literal content and execute no injected shell command.
3. A delayed startup can still read its file; missing/unreadable files give a clear failure, and cleanup follows the documented lifetime without deleting caller-owned files.
4. The two C11-258 harnesses and the tab:113 workflow show observed process/readiness evidence. An intentionally failing executable or continuation-prompt simulation is reported as failed/pending rather than started, within a documented bound.
5. The report distinguishes a proven launch-line cause from any independently observed H-A paste corruption. Startup checks do not activate the app or alter the operator’s workspace selection.

## Validation
Use an executable launcher/PTY harness that captures literal prompt bytes and startup result, then tests_v2 and a real tagged-artifact launch using the incident providers. A computer-use pass records the launched tab and absence of continuation prompts, plus process/runtime evidence. No full soak is required unless the implementation adds ongoing hot-path work; a bounded repeated-launch check belongs on Atlas. Preserve existing C11-258 history.

Builds and soaks run on Atlas once F1 / C11-216 lands, through the build lock. Use a tagged artifact and its socket, launched with C11_QA_LAUNCH=fresh (or the tagged automation launcher); never an untagged DEV app. Record exact artifact/head and distinguish fixture assertions from the real product pass. Update affected CLI/event skill contracts, run scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh for edited installable skills and verify the installed copy.

## Dependencies
Existing ticket: C11-258, update in place. Related C11-257 supplied the reproducer. H-A owns upstream #9875; add a hard dependency only if reproduction proves its fix is required, and report that to the lead through the ticket. C3 owns send delivery vocabulary; F1 / C11-216 supplies tagged build capacity.

## Risks
Quoting, TTY limits and paste framing can produce similar symptoms; prove the cause before choosing the patch. Private temporary prompts must not leak through public fixtures, command logs or launcher JSON. Keep telemetry parsing, I/O, deduplication and sorting off main; apply only the minimal UI mutation asynchronously. Preserve the hitTest pointer guard, TabItemView equality boundary and allocation-free forceRefresh path. No tenant config writes or trust broadening. Localize new product strings in English plus ja, uk, ko, zh-Hans, zh-Hant and ru; validate interpolation tokens. Sanitize fixtures, screenshots and logs before inclusion in this public repository.

Size: S. Tier: P1. Doctrine check: optional per-process observation and explicit operator actions only; no blocking bridge, automatic approval or persistent tenant configuration.
title: launch-agent: deliver long prompts by file reference and report startup truthfully
